image_description: Two large blue industrial plastic drums (repurposed as rain barrels) standing side-by-side on a wooden pallet outdoors. The left drum features white labels with illegible text, a green hose connected near the bottom, and a black pipe fitting at the base. The right drum is similar, with a visible hose connection. The tops of both barrels are fully visible within the frame, showing open bungs but no clear downspout diverters or mesh screens. A chain-link fence and vegetation are in the background.
